# green_ampt

Recorded 2026-11-17 through `fetch_soilgrids` (ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, depth 0-5cm, 40 x 40 cells at 0.0025 deg, EPSG:4326,
percent, nodata -9999 where the model masks water), one file per fraction, nothing edited:

- `baton_rouge_{sand,silt,clay}.tif` - bbox (-91.30, 30.30, -91.20, 30.40): silt loam, silty clay loam, silty clay.
- `desmoines_*` - (-93.70, 41.55, -93.60, 41.65): clay loam, silty clay loam, silty clay.
- `florida_*` - (-81.60, 27.70, -81.50, 27.80): sand, loamy sand, sandy loam, sandy clay loam.
- `gulf_*` - (-97.30, 29.00, -97.20, 29.10): sandy loam, loam, sandy clay loam.
